answer_1.quote: We adopt TabEAE as the backbone model, inheriting its key modules such as encoder, decoder, prompt templates, slot tables and span selectors.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates event argument spans and their corresponding roles based on prompt templates and slot filling.

answer_2.quote: Following previous works as evaluation metrics. Arg-I refers to the correctness of predicted arguments when the boundaries of the predicted arguments match with any golden arguments; Arg-C indicates correctness only when both the boundaries and role types of the predicted arguments are correct.
